column1: Maternity Leave. Female employees are entitled to paid maternity leave for the duration of 16 weeks or 4 months.
Paternity Leave. Male employees are entitled to 2 weeks of paid paternity leave.
Shared Parental Leave. Male employees are entitled to 1-4 weeks of paid shared parental leave.
Retirement. The minimum retirement age for all workers must be 65 years. Retirement age in accordance with the Retirement and Re-Employment Act is considered compliant.
Retrenchment. Employees who have worked for at least two years qualify for retrenchment benefits.
Employees are entitled to at least 7 days of paid annual leave after the first 12 months of continuous service

The employer must pay the employee for every day of medical leave. Gross rate of pay excluding shift work allowance for medical leave without hospitalisation. Full gross rate of pay for medical leave with hospitalisation.
Employee should be given a rest day without pay each week, which must be on Sunday or another day chosen by the employer
if the employee works less than 44 hours every alternate week, they can work up to 48 hours a week but capped at 88 hours in any continuous 2 week period
